IGUI_BU_RenamePrompt: Name of this utility panel (empty for the automatic name):

IGUI_BU_NoProducers_water: No water storage connected. Right-click a rain collector barrel outside to connect it.
IGUI_BU_GeneratorTip: A generator you switch off yourself is out of service: it is left off for servicing, the next one on standby takes over, and it starts again only when you switch it on. The one switched on last carries the load.
IGUI_BU_NotAllLoaded: Part of the building or the area around it is not loaded: the list may be incomplete.
IGUI_BU_UpgradeNote: Carries a load of up to %1.
IGUI_BU_ApiVersion: Needs another version of PZ Extension API.
IGUI_BU_Reason_noSquare: There is nothing to put it on.
IGUI_BU_Reason_noApi: PZ Extension API is not installed.

IGUI_BU_Reason_noProducer: There is no generator or water container there.
IGUI_BU_Reason_noDevice: That device is not near the utility panel.
IGUI_BU_Reason_cantAfford: You lack the tools, materials or skill.
IGUI_BU_BannerTripped: The breaker is down: bring the load to %1 or less, then push the lever up.
IGUI_BU_TimerTip: Timer: each click turns Always, Night, Day. Night runs it from dusk to dawn only, Day the other way round.
IGUI_BU_PreviewTrip: Over the limit: left on, it trips the breaker.
IGUI_BU_FilterNote: Showing %1 only. Click here to show all.
IGUI_BU_Ranges: Reaches devices, producers and other buildings' panels %1 tiles away.
IGUI_BU_Why_AboveTanks: no water storage at the height of %1 or above, so no water comes out there. Put a rain collector barrel on that building's roof and connect it, or a booster pump below
IGUI_BU_FloorReach: Its zone takes floors up to %1 above or below its own.
IGUI_BU_TimerNote: Devices can be put on timers.
IGUI_BU_BypassNote: Worn batteries are left out of the bank.
IGUI_BU_NeedsTier: In reach once that utility panel is tier %1.
IGUI_BU_OutsideTip: Unticked, only its supply is cut and the line stays. Take the line up at the device (right-click).
IGUI_BU_Menu_OnlyRoom: Only this room in the list
IGUI_BU_Reason_roomTaken: This room is in another utility panel's zone.
IGUI_BU_Notice_Zoned: %1 takes the %2 free rooms of its floor (a large building). Change it with Edit zone on the plan.
IGUI_BU_Notice_ZonedReach: %1 takes the %2 rooms of the floors it reaches, %3 to %4. Change it with Edit zone on the plan.
IGUI_BU_Notice_ZoneReach: %1's zone keeps to the floors it reaches, %2 to %3.
IGUI_BU_ZoneHint: Choose the rooms this panel takes: click a room to add or remove it; right-click for floors.
IGUI_BU_ZoneNote: Zone: %1 rooms of the building (Edit zone on the plan changes it)
IGUI_BU_ZoneEmpty: A zone keeps one room at least.
IGUI_BU_ZoneFar: This panel's zone takes %1 to %2 only.
IGUI_BU_ZoneFarSub: Another panel put on those floors takes them.
IGUI_BU_Menu_ZoneFloorAdd: Add this floor to the zone
IGUI_BU_Menu_ZoneFloorRemove: Remove this floor from the zone
IGUI_BU_Menu_ZoneFloorOnly: Make the zone this floor only
IGUI_BU_Reason_wholeTaken: This building's utility panel takes all of it: give that panel a zone on its plan first.
IGUI_BU_PlanHint: Wheel: zoom, drag: move; wheel over the floors: scroll them
IGUI_BU_LeverUpTip: Pull it down to cut all of this panel's power.
IGUI_BU_LeverDownTip: Push it up to switch the power back on.
IGUI_BU_LeverTripTip: Tripped by overload. Bring the load down and push it up.
IGUI_BU_BreakerHolds: Breaker heating: trips in %1 as it is
IGUI_BU_Rack_BankOutput: %1 at once, %2 stored, built for output
IGUI_BU_Rack_BankStorage: %1 at once, %2 stored, built for storage
IGUI_BU_ReviveNote: Condition +%1. This battery takes %2 more. Uses some baking soda.
IGUI_BU_Reason_notOutside: It goes outside under the open sky: on the ground or a flat roof.
IGUI_BU_Reason_rackNotEmpty: Take its batteries out first (in the loot window).
IGUI_BU_Reason_notBattery: It is not a car battery.
IGUI_BU_Reason_notWorn: Only a battery below condition %1 can be reconditioned.
IGUI_BU_Reason_bakingSoda: It takes two uses of baking soda.
IGUI_BU_SolarLightTip: One panel makes %1 in clear daylight. Daylight now %2.
IGUI_BU_SolarSnowTip: Snow on a panel takes its share.
IGUI_BU_SolarTip: Making at least the load (%1), the panels carry it instead of a generator; short of it, a generator takes over. A running generator keeps running until you use Switch to solar: it then waits on standby for the night. One you switch off yourself is out of service; switch it on, then Switch to solar, to put it back on standby.
IGUI_BU_BankTip: %1 batteries in %2 racks charge and give power together, keeping %3 of what goes in.
IGUI_BU_BankDragTip: The worst of them holds the bank back: the further below the best it is, the less can be drawn. Keep batteries alike together.
IGUI_BU_BankHeatTip: Above 30 degrees they wear faster; a cellar keeps them cool.
IGUI_BU_BankBypassTip: This panel leaves batteries below condition %1 out of the bank.
IGUI_BU_BankColdTip: Below freezing, the cold locks part of it.
IGUI_BU_BankEmptyTip: When they are empty a generator takes over.
IGUI_BU_SolarBankTip: What they make over the load (%1) charges the batteries; what they lack comes from them. While a generator runs, it all charges them.
IGUI_BU_UseSourceTip: Switch to solar: the solar panels and batteries take the load, and the generator waits on standby; it takes over again when they fall short.
IGUI_BU_Reason_sourceNotReady: Not yet: the solar panels make less than the load, and the batteries need more than %1.
IGUI_BU_Notice_BankLow: %1: the batteries are low; a generator takes over
IGUI_BU_GraphTitle: Last %1 hours: made (yellow), used (grey), batteries (green)   top %2
IGUI_BU_St_Off: Power switched off at the box
IGUI_BU_St_WaterEmpty: No water: the water storage is empty
IGUI_BU_Why_Grid: the grid still runs, no generator is needed
IGUI_BU_Why_Tripped: the load went over %1; switch devices off and push the lever up
IGUI_BU_Why_SwitchedOff: the lever is down: push it up at the box
IGUI_BU_Why_Night: the solar panels make nothing at night
IGUI_BU_Why_BankLow: the batteries fell to %1; the solar side takes over again at %2
IGUI_BU_Why_Priority: the generators before it are switched off, out of fuel or broken
IGUI_BU_Why_NoProducers: nothing is connected: right-click a generator or solar panel outside to connect it
IGUI_BU_Why_SourceShort: the solar panels make too little and the batteries are empty; power comes back once they are charged to %1
IGUI_BU_Why_GeneratorOff: the generator is switched off: switch it on
IGUI_BU_Why_NotLoaded: the generator is too far away to start; it takes over once you are near
IGUI_BU_Why_NoFuel: the generator is out of fuel
IGUI_BU_Why_NoTanks: no water storage is connected: right-click a rain collector barrel outside to connect it
IGUI_BU_NoDevices_power: No device that uses power was found here. Lights and appliances show up here once placed.
IGUI_BU_NoDevices_water: No fixture that uses water (sink, bathtub, toilet) was found here.
IGUI_BU_StatsCarried: Solar and batteries supplied power for %1
IGUI_BU_Why_Frozen: they thaw after %2 hours above %1 degrees; heat the building
IGUI_BU_Why_NoWaterHooks: PZ Extension API in this game cannot run the pipes (%1)
IGUI_BU_PlanRangeHint: Show where devices outside (blue) and producers (yellow) can connect, here and in the world
IGUI_BU_StripScroll: More floors (the wheel over the strip scrolls them too)
IGUI_BU_FloorRowOpen: Click to list this floor's rooms and show it on the plan
IGUI_BU_Reason_noMedia: It takes 2 charcoal and 1 ripped sheet.
IGUI_BU_Notice_FilterSpent: %1: the filter's media is spent, the water comes out unpurified
IGUI_BU_Pump_noTanks: stopped: no water storage seen yet
IGUI_BU_Pump_full: stopped: the water storage is full
IGUI_BU_Filter_restingNoRisk: resting: the pipes purify, since PZ Extension API in this game cannot keep the taint (%1)
IGUI_BU_UnitTip_pump: Lifts water from a river, a lake or a well right beside it into its pipe's water storage on its floor and below while its panel has power, a load of 0.12 while it runs. Once they are full it stops. Without water beside it, it runs dry: it draws its power and lifts nothing.
IGUI_BU_UnitTip_sprinkler: Waters the growing crops within 2 squares that need it, from its pipe, as a watering can would. It rests while it rains and once its pipe is down to its reserve.
IGUI_BU_UnitTip_filter: Passes water from its inlet pipe to the water storage of its outlet pipe on its floor and below. With the risk option 'pipes do not purify' on, it makes tainted water clean while its media lasts (30 days of use); on one pipe it purifies that pipe. Replace the media with 2 charcoal and 1 ripped sheet.
IGUI_BU_PipeTip: Water storage %1, fixtures %2. A fixture takes water from its pipe's water storage on its floor and the floors above.
IGUI_BU_PipeFlowOut_filter: A filter passes its water on to %1.
IGUI_BU_PipeFlowOut_booster: A booster pump lifts its water up to %1.
IGUI_BU_PipeFlowIn_booster: A booster pump lifts water into it from %1.
IGUI_BU_PipeFlow_boosterSame: A booster pump lifts its water to the floors above.
IGUI_BU_PipeUnpurifiedTip: The pipes do not purify: what its water storage holds comes out as it is.
IGUI_BU_PipeForeignTip: Water storage holding anything but water is left out of the pipe until it is emptied.
IGUI_BU_PipeCrossingTip: Its water crosses to the other buildings no higher than %1.
IGUI_BU_AddPipeTip: Lays a new pipe, %1, at the panel. Water on one pipe does not mix with another's: raw water and filtered water, say. Put a room, a fixture or water storage on it with the colour button on its row.
IGUI_BU_PipeNamePrompt: Name of this pipe (empty for its colour):
IGUI_BU_PipeChipTip: The pipe it is on. Click to change.
IGUI_BU_PipeInTip: The pipe it takes water from. Click to change.
IGUI_BU_PipeOutTip: The pipe it fills. Click to change.
IGUI_BU_RoomPipeTip: The pipe in this room's walls: its fixtures are on it unless you chose another. Click to change.
IGUI_BU_TooHighTip: No water storage on its pipe stands at its floor or above, so no water comes out here.
IGUI_BU_Booster_noTanks: stopped: no water storage above it on its pipe
IGUI_BU_Booster_full: stopped: the water storage above is full
IGUI_BU_Filter_noWater: waiting: no water at its inlet
IGUI_BU_Filter_noTanks: stopped: no water storage on its outlet pipe
IGUI_BU_Filter_full: stopped: the water storage on its outlet pipe is full
IGUI_BU_Pump_noWater: running dry: no water beside it
IGUI_BU_Reason_disabled: Turned off in the sandbox options.
IGUI_BU_PlanArriveTip: Supply from %1: %2. Click to go there
IGUI_BU_PlanRiserTip: The lines on this floor run on to the panel on %1. Click to go there
IGUI_BU_UnitTip_booster: Lifts water from its inlet pipe's water storage on its floor and below up to its outlet pipe's water storage on the floors above, as many as set in the sandbox (5 by default), while its panel has power, a load of 0.25 while it runs. Higher up, another one on a floor it fills lifts on from there.
IGUI_BU_Booster_noWater: waiting: no water at its inlet
IGUI_BU_Reason_exteriorOff: The sandbox option 'Generator Working in Exterior' is off: generators power nothing outdoors.
IGUI_BU_UnwiredTip: Lay its line at the device (right-click).
IGUI_BU_UnwiredProducerTip: Right-click it where it stands to connect it to this panel.
IGUI_BU_OwnSwitchOnTip: Its own switch is on. Turn it on or off at the device.
IGUI_BU_OwnSwitchOffTip: Its own switch is off. Turn it on or off at the device.
IGUI_BU_CutNote: Devices can be cut one by one at the panel.
IGUI_BU_HandoverTip: When the batteries fall to %1, a generator takes the load; once they are back to %2, the solar panels and batteries take it again.
IGUI_BU_HangsInZone: In its zone: no line needed.
IGUI_BU_HangsOn_relay: %1 tiles from a utility pole or yard hydrant
IGUI_BU_HangsOn_chain: %1 tiles from a device on the same line (%2 of %3 on it)
IGUI_BU_LineCut_relays: This panel's tier carries %1 utility poles or yard hydrants; this one is past them.
IGUI_BU_LineCut_chain: A wall, pole or hydrant carries at most %1 devices down its line; this one is past them.
IGUI_BU_LineCut_far: Its line from the wall is longer than the panel reaches (%1 tiles).
IGUI_BU_Reason_relays: This panel already has %1 utility poles or yard hydrants.
IGUI_BU_Reason_relaysMore: This panel already has %1 utility poles or yard hydrants; at the next tier it takes %2.
IGUI_BU_LineCut_here: Its own line is where the branch is cut: connect it again here.
IGUI_BU_Notice_BranchCut: %1: the line %2 away is cut; what hangs past it is not supplied.
IGUI_BU_ZoneFarRelay: A utility pole or yard hydrant in a building takes the rooms within %1 floors of it.
IGUI_BU_DeadBranchesTip: Click to show the next one on the plan.
IGUI_BU_RelayRowTip: Click to show it on the plan.
